text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
Phalaeno-san! 
Your student is here!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: ...So you've come. Now then—

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
—Let us see. 
Will your resolve... be a beacon guiding 
toward the future?

I gaze into the clear eyes of the 
Umamusume before me. 
Alongside memories I could never forget...

text_block_list.name: Famous Trainer
text_block_list.text:
—The injury my Umamusume suffered back 
then was completely unexpected. 
I struggled, but by carefully adjusting 
her regimen and rotation—

On my day off, I went to a nearby museum 
to watch a talk show. 
I listened to the experiences of a 
renowned Trainer who led Umamusume to 
glorious records.

As a rookie, I thought there'd be much to 
learn, but... 
Even for an outstanding mentor, hardship 
on the path of training never ceases.
choice_data_list:
(Can I... really guide an Umamusume all on 
my own?)

(Can I... really guide an Umamusume all on 
my own?)

text_block_list.text:
How many trials will strike an Umamusume 
before she reaches the grand stage? 
...What if a poor decision on my part 
pushes her too far, and my Umamusume—

Gets cast into a darkness from which she 
can never rise again?

...Hurriedly, I left the museum. 
No matter how much I thought about it, 
anxiety kept swirling in my mind.

And so, I visited a nearby shrine with a 
scenic view. 
It seemed open for public viewing, and as 
I walked inside and strolled around—
—Hah, hmph—seyaah!

A large naginata slices through the air, 
drawing a graceful arc. 
I was completely captivated by her 
refined, elegant movements...

...Hm? 
Pray tell, what are you watching?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
—A Trainer from the Academy, I see. Pardon 
my bluntness. 
I am Phalaenopsis.
choice_data_list: That kata just now was stunning.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. I have trained here for a long 
time, you see. 
When it comes to focusing the mind, the 
martial arts are essential.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
As a Trainer, surely you understand. 
A resilient spirit is indispensable in our 
battles.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Racing is not merely about physical 
strength and technique. 
Only those who can master and discipline 
their own hearts will seize victory.
choice_data_list: (All for the sake of racing... huh...)

text_block_list.text:
Phalaenopsis, an Umamusume like a 
dignified, classical princess. 
Her resolute determination overlapped with 
that master Trainer from the lecture.
choice_data_list:
...That's a wonderful mindset. It's truly 
inspiring.

...That's a wonderful mindset. It's truly 
inspiring.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
—No. Tell me, do you have any experience 
in martial arts?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Now then—take your stance. 
A spar. Come at me with everything you 
have.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Come, worry not. I shall hold back. 
...Harboring such turbidity will only 
cloud your heart.

Her gaze pierces right through me, seeing 
all. 
Feeling its sheer intensity, a shiver runs 
straight down my spine.
choice_data_list: ...All right, I'll give it a shot.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
The sword is wielded not with the flesh, 
but with the heart. 
Confront your own spirit. ...—Hah!

A sharp shock shoots through my palms. The 
shinai parrying the blow buzzes in my 
hands. 
Unlike her graceful dance, this strike is 
fierce and raw...!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Patience alone will not suffice! 
Cast away the turbidity in your heart with 
all your might!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
—Yes, that spirit! 
Turn your blade inward upon your soul!

Strength surges into the hands gripping 
the hilt. 
The anxiety, the doubt, the fear of 
leading another... Yes, this turbidity 
is...!
choice_data_list:
I'm terrified of deciding an Umamusume's 
future...!!

text_block_list.text:
Spotting an opening, I swing the shinai 
down with all my momentum—and in that 
instant—

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Haaah!!

—I couldn't even tell what happened. 
Before I knew it, the shinai was sent 
flying from my hands, and the tip of her 
blade was pointed at me.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
To cut through your anguish, you must 
first look upon it without flinching.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...I see, so it is the fear of being a 
guide. 
In that case... would you care to visit my 
training club with me?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, the home where I was raised. At 
that place, 
you may find something to learn as a 
mentor... What say you?

A training club... True, at an institution 
outside the Academy, 
I might just find a hint to overcome my 
current dilemma.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Very well—then I shall show you the way 
tomorrow. 
I had planned to pay a visit around this 
time anyway.

And so, the next day, she led me to... 
An open-air training ground surrounded by 
seasonal blossoms in full bloom.

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Phalaeno-san! You came to visit again! 
We were just tending to the flowers!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Oh? Then let me have a look later. 
Now then—gather everyone. Once they're 
here, we shall begin practice.
choice_data_list:
Practice... Are you helping out at the 
club?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Yes. While the club provides formal 
guidance... 
I look after them from time to time 
whenever I return like this.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Now then, permit me to say it once 
more—welcome, Trainer.
